benchmark.purpose: Compare context and response compression without treating smaller output as success unless critical facts survive.

memory.responsibility: Retain fixture source, critical facts, adapter identity, and verification evidence.

planning.responsibility: Run identical fixtures through control and compressor adapters.

capability.responsibility: Invoke only the compressor required for the current benchmark arm.

action.responsibility: Measure before/after size, run the real adapter, verify retained facts, and emit a machine-readable receipt.

required: before and after sizes are recorded
information loss is reported even when compression ratio is high

claim_boundary: Estimated token counts are provider-neutral comparison units, not provider billing tokens. Third-party compression claims are not adopted until the installed adapter is measured on these fixtures.
